title: Raw Glass and Glassworking Practices Beyond the Roman limes: A Case Study of the Late Roman Workshop in Komarov (Middle Dniester, Western Ukraine)
bibliographicNote: Acta Archaeologica Academiae Scientiarum Hungaricae 74(1), pp. 51–69. Chemical analysis of 42 raw glass samples identifies groups of Egyptian and Levantine origin and evidence of recycling.
